space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

source.description: A page's markup or code, at most 262 144 UTF-8 bytes; tags are found in it

detail.description: api: the floor and the API sections with rule ids only. brief: every section but detail and cssProperties, without the rules the attributes name. full: every section

sections.description: Exactly these sections, in place of detail's choice

known.description: Rule ids the caller already holds, each bare or <library>/<id>: their ids stay in entries and their text is not sent

versions.description: The versions the caller has installed, npm package name to version, at most 32 entries

render.description: text: the answer's content is data.text, a quoted block

maxBytes.description: The most bytes of the whole result, as the output budget measures it; the smaller of this and the call's budget applies
